messages.text: Handed to the team · Warehouse exception my tools cannot clear; customer asked when his pre-order shi

Hi Shane. Your Harlo B30 now ships November 15, 2026, and the Power K. goes with it. Nothing has shipped yet.

We emailed you about this on November 3, with factory photos and the mid-November rollout. Since our mail went to promos last time, it might be worth a look there.

Because your order ships to the UAE, I've asked the team to check the customs paperwork so it doesn't get held up. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET and will confirm by email. You can follow the batch at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
i never get email updates, i mentioned this before.
Handed to the team · Second report that our emails never arrive; I cannot check deliverability or sup

I know you did, Shane, and I'm sorry it's still happening. Our record shows emails going to you on September 15 and November 3, but if they aren't reaching you, that's a problem on our side to fix.

I've asked the team to check why our order emails aren't getting through to your Hotmail address. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET.

For now, the key facts: your B30 and Power K. ship November 15. You can check progress any time at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, so you don't have to rely on email.
why does the shipping date keep getting moved

Fair question, Shane, and you deserve a straight answer. The B30's cooling was redesigned to make the unit quieter, and that pushed the first batches back. Then production ran slower than we told you it would. We gave you dates we didn't keep, more than once, and that's on us.

Here's where things are now. B30 batch 2 has shipped and batch 3 left on November 4. The units are going out through mid-November, and yours ships November 15.

The free Power K. we added for the delay ships in the same box.
